changelog:
personwise-content-repurposing 2.1.9

- Clarifies that installing or updating the PersonWise CLI may occur only with explicit user approval.
- Updates CLI usage guidance: by default, always use the market-bound CLI/service; only switch if the user explicitly requests a different PersonWise market release.
- Strengthens rules around account usage: use only accounts for the selected market.
- Removes the sample skill-card.md file.
- Adds explicit allowed-tools and permissions (Bash) to the skill manifest.
- Updates the attribution skill version in documentation.
summary: Turn recordings and transcripts into an askable digital-human course.
